name: FeedWise – AI Product Feed for WooCommerce
author: Md Al Sharif Hossain

sections.description:
FeedWise turns your WooCommerce catalog into product feeds that shopping and social channels can read. Pick a channel, and the required fields are mapped for you. Adjust anything you like, preview the result, and give the channel your feed URL.

Built for large catalogs. Feeds are written to disk in small batches, so memory use stays flat whether you have 500 products or 500,000. The public feed file is only replaced once a new version is complete, so channels never download a half-written feed.

Channels included

  • Google Merchant Center (XML, CSV, TSV)
  • Meta – Facebook and Instagram catalogs (XML, CSV, TSV)
  • TikTok catalog (CSV, TSV)
  • Pinterest catalogs (XML, CSV, TSV)
  • Microsoft Merchant Center / Bing (XML, TSV)
  • Custom feeds (XML, CSV, TSV, JSON)

Features

  • Field mapping from product data, attributes, custom fields, taxonomies, fixed text or text patterns such as {brand} {title} - {attr:pa_color}
  • Clean-up steps: remove HTML and shortcodes, shorten text at word boundaries, change letter case, replace text and more
  • Channel-correct values: prices with currency, stock wording each channel expects, weights with units
  • Variable products as one row per variation, parent only, or both, with item group IDs
  • Include or leave out categories and individual products; skip out-of-stock, hidden, unpriced or image-less products
  • Brand, MPN and condition fields on the product screen; uses the WooCommerce GTIN field and WooCommerce Brands when available
  • Prices including or excluding tax, plus UTM tracking parameters on product links
  • Automatic updates through WooCommerce’s Action Scheduler (twice daily, daily or weekly)
  • Live preview of feed rows before you generate
  • WP-CLI: wp feedwise list and wp feedwise generate <id>|--all
  • REST API under /wp-json/feedwise/v1/ for developers
  • Compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install FeedWise from Plugins → Add New, or upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Activate the plugin and open Product Feeds in the admin menu.
  4. Click Add feed, choose a channel, then Generate now.
  5. Copy the feed URL into your channel’s product data settings.
sections.faq:
Where are feed files stored?

In wp-content/uploads/feedwise/. Each feed has a stable URL based on its name, so channels can fetch it on a schedule.

My host times out during generation. What can I do?

Go to Product Feeds → Settings and lower “Products per batch”. Generation continues in the background through Action Scheduler, so you can leave the page.

Does the plugin send my data anywhere?

No. The plugin does not contact any external service. Feed files are created on your own server and only shared with the channels you give the URL to.

Can I add my own channels or fields?

Yes. Developers can register merchant templates through the fdws_merchant_dirs filter, add product properties with fdws_product_properties, and adjust rows with fdws_row.

0.1.0

  • First release: streaming feed engine, six channel templates, field mapping, preview, scheduling, product feed fields, REST API and WP-CLI.
